name: Fabric Graph
description: **Fabric Graph (preview)** is scalable native graph service built directly into Microsoft Fabric.  • **Model connected data natively on OneLake** – represent interconnected data points as labeled property graphs without managing ETL or data replication pipelines.• **Explore visually** – uncover hidden connections in seconds through low-/no-code user interfaces tailored for developers as well as business users.• **Query with open standards** – run pattern analysis using GQL-compliant syntax and REST endpoints.• **Enterprise-grade governance** – unified security, lineage, and scale-out compute inherited from Fabric ensure reliable, real-time analytics at petabyte scale.  Fabric Graph accelerates decision-making by transforming disconnected data into AI-driven insights—unlocking interconnected analytics within Microsoft Fabric.
